edges.reason: mint gates whitelist and public phases on block.timestamp.
msg.sender drives whitelist mint accounting and owner-based payment exemption.
mint queries remaining allowed mints for the caller.
mint increments the caller mint count when whitelisted.
mint enforces MAX_SUPPLY using totalSupply().
mint reads token price via tokenPrice(id).
mint calls _owner to allow owner minting without payment.
mint performs the actual token creation via _mint.
mint increments the supplyCounter after minting.
token id parameter flows into mint logic.
token id parameter indexes mintPriceMap via tokenPrice.
multimint is restricted by onlyOwner using _owner.
multimint mints each id via _mint.
multimint increments the supplyCounter per minted id.
array of ids flows into the multimint loop.
loop-local id drives each _mint call in multimint.
withdraw sends ETH via low-level call forwarding all gas, enabling reentrancy.
withdraw routes 90% of balance to the owner returned by _owner.
withdraw sends 5% of balance to payoutAddress1.
withdraw sends 5% of balance to payoutAddress2.
local balance snapshot flows into the withdraw payout split.
allowedMintCount reads allowedMintCountMap.
allowedMintCount reads mintCountMap.
minter address indexes the whitelist maps.
updateMintCount writes mintCountMap.
count parameter is added to the minter mint count.
tokenPrice reads mintPriceMap.
totalSupply reads the supplyCounter.
_mint performs an external base().__mint call that can invoke hook callbacks.
setBaseURI is restricted by onlyOwner via _owner.
new base URI parameter flows into _setBaseURI.
token id parameter flows into the tokenURI lookup.
constructor seeds allowedMintCountMap for whitelisted addresses.
constructor seeds mintPriceMap with per-id prices.
_burn delegates to base().__burn external call in the same contract context.

normalization_plan.reason: Token id parameter is only used within mint and should be folded into the mint function node.
ids array parameter is only consumed by the multimint loop and should merge into multimint.
minter parameter is only used to index maps inside allowedMintCount.
Local balance snapshot is only used for withdraw payout math.
customBaseURI_ parameter is only forwarded by setBaseURI.
tokenId parameter is only used by tokenURI lookup.
Loop-local id exists solely inside multimint iteration.
count parameter is only consumed by updateMintCount arithmetic.
